report: XFuel Protocol — ZK Hybrid Prover Audit Baseline

succinct_sp1.architecture: Multilinear polynomial proof system with Jagged PCS, replacing univariate STARK (Plonky3). RISC-V zkVM targeting riscv32im-succinct-zkvm-elf.
key_innovations: Jagged Polynomial Commitment Scheme — pay-only-for-what-you-use architecture
LogUp GKR sumcheck protocol for multilinear-friendly verification
STARK-to-SNARK wrapping: STARK core -> recursive STARK -> Groth16/PLONK on BN254
Full formal verification of all 62 RISC-V opcodes (Nethermind + EF collaboration)

performance.ethereum_proving: 93% of mainnet blocks in <12s (avg 10.3s) with 16x RTX 5090 GPUs

on_chain_verification.interface: ISP1Verifier.verifyProof(bytes32 programVKey, bytes publicValues, bytes proofBytes)
on_chain_verification.supported_chains: Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, and 9+ others (not Theta natively)

risc_v_deviations: Target: riscv32im-succinct-zkvm-elf (custom Succinct toolchain, not standard riscv32im)
Programs compile via 'cargo prove build' using succinct Rust toolchain
Docker required for reproducible builds ('cargo prove build --docker')
No floating-point support (rv32im = integer + multiply, no F/D extensions)
System calls are replaced with SP1 precompile hooks (IO, hashing, pairing)

entry_points.instantiate: Called once on deployment. Args: DepsMut, Env, MessageInfo, InstantiateMsg. Returns Result<Response, ContractError>.
entry_points.execute: Handles state-changing messages. Args: DepsMut, Env, MessageInfo, ExecuteMsg.
entry_points.query: Read-only queries. Args: Deps, Env, QueryMsg. Returns StdResult<Binary>.
entry_points.migrate: Called on contract migration (not yet implemented in xfuel verifiers).

cosmwasm.entry_point_macro: #[cfg_attr(not(feature = "library"), entry_point)] wraps Rust types for WASM runtime. 'library' feature disables exports for dependency usage.

storage_plus.Item: Typed wrapper around single DB key. Const fn constructor for compile-time definition. Methods: save(), load(), may_load(), update().
storage_plus.Map: Multiple typed objects under prefix, indexed by simple/compound keys. Methods: save(), load(), may_load(), remove(), range(). Keys transparently converted to bytes.

mock_testing.multi_test: cw-multi-test (v0.20) for integration testing with multiple contracts
mock_testing.pattern: Unit tests use #[cfg(test)] mod tests with mock_dependencies for isolated state

should_remove_a_circuit.error: Arithmetic operation overflowed (panic 0x11) at removeCircuit — circuitCount underflow
should_remove_a_circuit.root_cause: BUG in registerCircuit(): circuitCount increment guard checks circuits[circuitId] == bytes32(0) AFTER the mapping was already set to programVKey on line 132, so the condition is always false and circuitCount never increments. removeCircuit() then underflows on circuitCount--.

should_reject_duplicate_nullifier.error: TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object in findCustomErrorByName
should_reject_duplicate_nullifier.root_cause: Hardhat chai-matchers cannot resolve custom errors from the contract ABI. Likely version mismatch between hardhat-chai-matchers and ethers v6, or the compiled artifact doesn't export custom errors correctly with viaIR enabled. The underlying contract logic IS correct — the transaction does revert.
should_reject_duplicate_nullifier.severity: LOW (test harness issue, not contract bug)

should_pause_and_unpause.note: The EnforcedPause error comes from OpenZeppelin Pausable, which may not be in the ZKVerifierSP1 artifact's error list

verifyProof_mock_mode.note: Mock mode (gateway=0x0). Real Groth16 gateway adds ~270K.

verifyProofBatch_3_proofs.note: 3 mock proofs. ~58K per proof in batch.

nullifier_tracking.detail: usedNullifiers mapping checked before marking. Optimistic mark (line 182) prevents re-entry with same nullifier via ReentrancyGuard + pre-check pattern.

replay_protection.detail: bytes32 nullifier is globally unique. Once used, cannot be reused. Combined with circuit breaker for anomaly detection.

ProofFailed.status: PARTIAL — not emitted in batch verification for individual failures

gas_analysis.wrapper_overhead: ~107K in mock mode (includes nullifier storage + event + metrics)
gas_analysis.target_met: Wrapper overhead <100K target is MET if excluding initial storage writes. First-time nullifier write costs ~20K extra (cold SSTORE).
gas_analysis.groth16_target_270K: NOT MET — total is ~300K. Gateway alone is ~270K; wrapper adds overhead.

circuit_breaker.detail: Triggers auto-pause at >5% failure rate over 100+ verifications in 1-hour window. Edge case: _updateMetrics and totalVerified/totalFailed are both incremented, creating double-counting of verificationsInWindow.

bugs_found.title: circuitCount never increments — registerCircuit logic error
bugs_found.description: Line 132 sets circuits[circuitId] = programVKey, then line 134 checks if circuits[circuitId] == bytes32(0) to increment circuitCount. Since the value was just set, the condition is always false. circuitCount stays at 0. removeCircuit then underflows on circuitCount--.
bugs_found.fix: Move the circuitCount check BEFORE setting the mapping, or use a separate 'was_registered' check: bool isNew = circuits[circuitId] == bytes32(0); circuits[circuitId] = programVKey; if (isNew) circuitCount++;

bugs_found.title: Batch verification skips ProofFailed events for individual failures
bugs_found.description: verifyProofBatch silently continues on failed proofs (sets results[i] = false) but does not emit ProofFailed events. Downstream monitoring cannot detect batch failures.
bugs_found.fix: Add emit ProofFailed(circuitIds[i], msg.sender, 'BatchItemFailed', block.timestamp) in the else branch.

bugs_found.title: Batch _updateMetrics called with hardcoded true
bugs_found.description: _updateMetrics(true) is called once at end of batch regardless of individual results. The bool parameter is unused in the function body anyway, but the window tracking doesn't account for actual batch failure counts correctly.
bugs_found.fix: Either remove the bool parameter from _updateMetrics or call it per-item.

nullifier_tracking.status: DIFFERENT APPROACH — uses theta_tx_hash as replay key
nullifier_tracking.detail: PROOF_RECORDS Map keyed by theta_tx_hash. Prevents same tx hash from being used twice. This is semantically different from a cryptographic nullifier — it ties replay protection to an external transaction identifier.

mock_verification.detail: verify_groth16_mock() validates proof structure (A=2 elements, B=2x2, C=2 elements, public_inputs non-empty) but always returns true. No path to real BN254 verification.
mock_verification.severity: HIGH for production, acceptable for testnet

bugs_found.title: No circuit registry — any proof structure accepted
bugs_found.description: Unlike the core-layer version, this contract has no circuit registry. Any caller can submit any proof for any tx hash. No program vkey validation.

bugs_found.title: Nonce stored but not validated
bugs_found.description: The nonce field is stored in ProofRecord but never checked for sequential ordering or uniqueness. It provides no additional replay protection.

bugs_found.title: Missing migrate entry point
bugs_found.description: No #[entry_point] fn migrate() defined. Contract cannot be upgraded via CosmWasm migration.

nullifier_tracking.detail: NULLIFIERS Map<&str, bool> checked via may_load before saving. String-keyed nullifiers are unique per proof submission.

replay_protection.detail: Nullifier + circuit registry + vkey matching provides three-layer protection: (1) nullifier uniqueness, (2) circuit must be registered, (3) submitted vkey must match registered vkey.

mock_verification.detail: In mock_mode, all proofs accepted. In production mode, verify_sp1_proof_wasm() is a skeleton: validates non-empty proof and length >= 128 bytes, then returns true. No actual BN254 pairing.

circuit_registry.detail: CIRCUITS Map stores CircuitInfo (program_vkey, label). Admin-only registration/removal with proper error handling.

bugs_found.title: verify_sp1_proof_wasm is a skeleton — no actual cryptographic verification
bugs_found.description: Production mode only checks proof byte length >= 128. Any 128+ byte hex string passes verification. Needs bn254-wasm or arkworks-wasm integration for real Groth16 pairing.
bugs_found.fix: Integrate ark-groth16 with wasm32-unknown-unknown target support, or use a precompile-based approach if the target chain supports BN254 precompiles.

bugs_found.title: Missing migrate entry point
bugs_found.description: No migrate handler. Contract cannot be upgraded via standard CosmWasm migration path.

bugs_found.title: No batch verification support
bugs_found.description: Unlike the EVM version, no batch verification endpoint exists. Each proof requires a separate transaction.

critical.description: Fix circuitCount increment: check if circuit was previously unregistered BEFORE setting the mapping value.

high.description: Replace skeleton with real BN254 Groth16 pairing verification. Candidate libraries: ark-bn254 (with wasm feature), or sp1-verifier crate (supports no_std).
Emit ProofFailed events for individual batch item failures. Add per-item metrics tracking.

medium.description: Add circuit registry (align with v2 design) or deprecate in favor of core-layer/wasm/zk-verifier.
Add #[entry_point] fn migrate() for contract upgradeability.

low.description: Fix revertedWithCustomError assertions. Use .to.be.reverted or update hardhat-chai-matchers to a version compatible with ethers v6 + viaIR artifacts.
Add batch verification endpoint (ExecuteMsg::VerifyProofBatch) for parity with EVM contract.

architecture_notes.dual_verifier_design: EVM (ZKVerifierSP1.sol) and CosmWasm (xfuel-zk-verifier) provide parallel verification paths for Theta (EVM) and Persistence/Osmosis (Cosmos) chains.
architecture_notes.sp1_gateway_dependency: EVM verifier delegates to ISP1Verifier gateway. Gateway is not deployed on Theta — mock mode (gateway=0x0) required for Theta testnet/mainnet until Succinct deploys or XFuel self-deploys a gateway.
architecture_notes.cosmwasm_bn254_gap: CosmWasm verifier needs a WASM-compatible BN254 pairing library. sp1-verifier crate supports no_std but may not compile to wasm32-unknown-unknown without patches.
architecture_notes.nullifier_semantic_difference: EVM uses bytes32 keccak256 nullifiers. CosmWasm v1 uses theta_tx_hash strings. CosmWasm v2 uses hex-encoded string nullifiers. Cross-chain nullifier synchronization is not addressed.
